title: Paloma and the Glasshouse
author: O. M. Sandoval
blurb: Rosalind Pemberton, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
